title: Units of measure R1: show a quantity with its unit label
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Units of measure, release R1 (ADR-0158 U7). Parent: #35339. The ADR is the governing text: [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md) (merged PR #35370, 35bd36082c). Filed on seat 5's word, 2026-11-19.

## What to build
R1 member "display of the value with its unit", mirroring ADR-0144's per-row display. A standard code gets the platform's per-locale label (2A). An org code gets its one label. A deleted org unit shows the code without a label (L1).

## Open items this card carries
- **OI10, ruled A on #35339 (「组织可改,新开一处设置」):** an org admin sets display decimals for any standard code in a new setting place (#35498); this card reads it, and `sys_unit`'s field for an org code.
- OI6, second half: what a unit's display default does with a stored value that has more places, given that "never exceed the field's scale" can act only at render.
- **OI8, ruled A on #35339:** a standalone unit field (declared on its own) also renders with its label and gets the picker.

## Blocked
Blocked-by: #35498
Blocked-by: #35489

Waits on the unitConfig and membership card and on the standard-unit decimals setting (#35498).

## Done when
A record-mode and a fixed-mode quantity render with their unit label in grid, form and detail. A deleted org unit renders as the bare code. Decimals follow OI10's answer and L4 (the field's `scale` is the ceiling). ADR-0158 is amended.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:ui.
